title: Cost-Sharing Cap and Claim Adjustment Limits by Category
content:
Member cost sharing on the Medicaid Managed Care Membership is protected by an aggregate cap expressed as a percent of household income over a cap period, and booked claims may have their member cost share adjusted only within a fixed number of days. The figures for every eligibility category are these.

## Limits by eligibility category

| Category | Cap percent of household income | Cap period (calendar months) | Pharmacy copays count toward the cap | Refund due within (calendar days) | Claim adjustment window (calendar days after the original claim's booked date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 5.00 | 3 | Yes | 30 | 365 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 5.00 | 3 | Yes | 30 | 365 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 5.00 | 12 | Yes | 45 | 365 |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 5.00 | 3 | Yes | 30 | 365 |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 5.00 | 3 | Yes | 30 | 365 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 5.00 | 3 | Yes | 30 | 365 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 5.00 | 3 | Yes | 30 | 365 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Cap percent.** The aggregate member cost-sharing cap as a percent of household income for the cap period, stated to two decimals: 5.00 percent in every category.
- **Cap period.** A cap period of 3 months means the calendar quarters beginning in January, April, July and October; a cap period of 12 months means the calendar year. Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids is the only category with a 12-month cap period.
- **Pharmacy copays.** Where this column reads Yes, pharmacy copays recorded on fills under the Pharmacy Benefit count toward the cap. It reads Yes in every category.
- **Refund days.** The calendar days, counted from the booked date of the claim an over-cap refund is booked against, within which that refund is due: 45 in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids and 30 in every other category.
- **Claim adjustment window.** The calendar days after an original claim's booked date within which its member cost share may be adjusted: 365 in every category.

## Hypothetical calendar reading

*Hypothetical service dates.* For a Prairie Ridge Family Care member, services on 3 February and on 28 March fall in the same cap period (January to March), while a service on 2 April opens the next one (April to June). For a Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids member, all three services fall in the same cap period, the calendar year.
